t: 2032 — First long-duration thrust coordination testbed runs a sealed en
title: 2032 — First long-duration thrust coordination testbed runs a sealed en
definition: 2032 milestone on the Stellar Engine Fleets roadmap.
description:
First long-duration thrust coordination testbed runs a sealed engine hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the caplan thrusters recycling math.

What must be true first: the caplan thrusters results have to replicate outside the lab, fleet propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and stellar control operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed caplan thrusters demonstrations, fleet propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting stellar control uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Stellar Engine Fleets readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a engine hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Stellar Engine Fleets Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Stellar Engine Fleets operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Stellar Engine Fleets installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 36319 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where caplan thrusters monitoring, fleet propulsion redundancy, or stellar control maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Stellar Engine Fleets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Stellar Engine Fleets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Stellar Engine Fleets — fleets of engines that steer stars themselves.

Phase 1 — Prove (caplan thrusters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fleet propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (stellar control): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (thrust coordination): engine hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and stellar neighborhood-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
